Block contains: (a) core semantic — `AT TIME ZONE` DOES NOT change underlying instant, just re-renders in given zone (Trino docs example verbatim: `timestamp '2012-10-31 01:00 UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'` → `2012-10-30 18:00:00.000 America/Los_Angeles`); (b) PREFERRED form — sargable zone-aware boundary-literal half-open range: `created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01 00:00:00 America/New_York' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01 00:00:00 America/New_York'` with explicit note that this partition-prunes against Iceberg day()/month() partitioning; (c) ALSO CORRECT form — `CAST(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS date) >= DATE '...'` with explicit caveat that wrapping the column defeats partition pruning (link to github.com/trinodb/trino/issues/12729 unwrap-cast optimizer gap) — use for small scans only; (d) THREE DO-NOT-WRITE bans: (i) `BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'` with bare VARCHAR strings on TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE — TYPE ERROR at analysis (no implicit VARCHAR→timestamptz coercion in Trino 467); (ii) `AT TIME ZONE 'X' >= DATE '...'` — SEMANTICALLY MISLEADING (DATE coerces to a timestamp at midnight in a way that does NOT match the local-NYC-midnight intent; produces silently-wrong off-by-hours rows); (iii) `current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'X'` as historical lower bound — ZERO ROWS (same instant as current_timestamp; `AT TIME ZONE` re-labels not subtracts); plus the correct 'last 7 NYC local days' anchor forms (`date_trunc('day', current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') - INTERVAL '7' DAY` vs rolling instant-based `current_timestamp - INTERVAL '7' DAY` — pick consciously); (e) summary cheat-sheet table mapping intent to CORRECT vs WRONG forms (4 rows: local-date range / on-or-after local date / last 7 NYC days / derive local date for GROUP BY); (f) closing reflex: JVM `-Duser.timezone` is NOT the lever — SQL-level (SET TIME ZONE / sql.forced-session-time-zone / per-expression AT TIME ZONE) IS — cross-ref to r22 §13.x for federation case.
